notes.zh:
- 修复部分机型（华为 ROM）shell 服务启动超时：agent 执行 shell 命令不再报「did not start within 30 s」
- 手机权限：已授权的条目新增「取消授权」按钮，可跳转系统页面撤销授权
- 「shell 权限」入口去掉「（实验）」字样
notes.en:
- Fix shell service bind timeout on some devices (Huawei ROM): agent shell commands no longer fail with "did not start within 30 s"
- Phone permissions: granted entries now have a Revoke button that opens the matching system page
- Drop the "(experimental)" marker from the shell access entry
